name: S-seeded products — S3 Software Factory
description: Whole-first wave-1 corpus artifact for the Software Factory product corpus, seeded from the essay's S3 record (L3 Processual / L2′ Alchemical-Elemental; movement 40 of §5). The whole path is S3's own movement structure #0 → #5→0, read from the authored bytes at Antykathera-Essay-Work 7d96ada2. Each scene binds the S3 record (path + sha256) and one material record from the frozen P1-census-factory inventory (6 of 230 records; every bound record byte-identical to EpiLogos/Factory origin/main f59368de6, verified 2026-09-21). Admission: the S register (T25 census, register episteme). Scene texts compress and quote the records, never invent claims; tints, formations and layout are declared craft (profiles/s-products-corpus-base). Wave-1 slice, not corpus-complete.

scenes.name: Becoming otherwise
scenes.character: Software Factory is transformation: intention, action, encounter and learning become changed form; transformation is complete only where returned experience reaches what can alter subsequent becoming.

text.title: Becoming otherwise
text.italic: Software Factory is transformation: intention becomes changed form.

scenes.name: L3 Processual — desire enters actuality
scenes.character: Concrescent desire, actual occasion, ingression, eternal objects, community integration, satisfaction/perishing: possibility becomes consequential by entering actuality; actuality answers.

scenes.name: L2′ Alchemical-Elemental — a material grammar
scenes.character: Aether, Earth, Water, Air, Fire, Salt: transformation is not abstractly procedural; becoming costs something, and what precipitates as a clean artifact may conceal who bore the costs.

scenes.name: Gate, Recognition and the commission
scenes.character: A Gate decides whether a candidate satisfies a declared condition; Recognition asks what the encounter means for the conditions themselves — a test can pass while the task was misframed.

scenes.name: Labour, Power and developmental consequence
scenes.character: Commission, implementation, review, use and consequence may belong to different bearers; if a report cannot reach the criterion that governs the work, feedback remains extraction.

scenes.name: The product of development is a changed field
scenes.character: Code is integrated, a concept clarified, a method retired, a project map changed: satisfaction perishes into inheritance, and the field becomes capable of another movement.

text.title: The product of development is a changed field
